title: Moving a part to another Part Sale keeps its price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 2, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set.
  • Make sure tier A's rule in matrix A was changed to % Off 20 after the part was priced.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Move the part to Part Sale 2.
  3. Open Part Sale 2.
  4. Point at the part's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Sale 1 opens with the part at $121.50.

Step 2:

  • The part leaves Part Sale 1.

Step 3:

  • On Part Sale 2 the part reads $121.50, not $108.00.
  • Priced by still names tier A ($135.00 × 0.80 = $108.00 would have been the new price).

Step 4:

  • The details still name customer A as the customer it was priced for.
